issue.title: dependency-link-consumption cross-file setLocal 1000 ms waitUntil flakes under full npm test load

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed during the bob-cli-nh.7.1 intention-card landing on bob-plugins b1a655a plus uncommitted intention-card changes (none touch dependency links or navigation-hotkeys). Full `npm test` (default parallel node --test, ~2150% CPU) failed this node once in two full runs: waitUntil at scripts/test-navigation-dependency-link-consumption.cjs:53 (called from :498) hit its default 1000 ms Date.now() timeout with "cross-file setLocal did not consume the live link" (test duration 1688 ms). The second full run passed it, and the file passed 19/19 in isolation on both the clean base and the changed tree. Root cause looks like a fixed 1000 ms polling bound on asynchronous cross-file consumption that parallel suite load exceeds, not a functional regression. Fail rate: 1 of 2 full parallel runs, 0 of 2 serial file runs. Make the wait load-tolerant (await the writer's own completion or a deterministic signal) without weakening the consumption assertion (compare bob-cli-m1 for another load-sensitive dependency node).

issue.creation_reason: The intention-card landing's full bob-plugins npm test failed this unrelated polling node once; it passes in isolation on base and change and no bead tracks it.
